mobileTitle: Climate and Active Design in Midtown (CD5)
reportHeader: Climate and Active Design in Midtown (CD5) Climate and Active Design Climate change is driving higher temperatures and more frequent and intense rainfall and storms. Approximately 500 New Yorkers die from heat each summer. Active design is an approach to creating streets, buildings and neighborhoods that promote the physical and mental health and well-being of residents. Print Download (downloads a CSV file) Expand all
